summary: Split 1c: fades, overlay dim, cursor and performance monitor in screen space
author: pm
body:
Screen and teleport fades and the overlay dim use `fill_output` (dim rect was one pixel short); the software cursor and performance monitor draw last in screen space; screenshot captures the window.

**Done when:** fades cover the whole window, cursor is sharp at 1440x1080; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.

**Verified, 2026-11-23:** Opus review passed after two fix rounds; Debug build 0 errors. Not yet run in game.
